import cadquery as cq
result = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .box(95.5, 82.2, 57.8)
    .faces(">Z").workplane()
    .center(0.0, 0.0)
    .rect(36.4, 97.5)
    .cutBlind(-57.8)
    .faces("<Z").workplane()
    .pushPoints([(34.45, 27.8), (-34.45, 27.8), (34.45, -27.8), (-34.45, -27.8)])
    .hole(4.0)
)
show_object(result)
